_doc: 08 §4.1-4.3 (merge, enhance, salvage) and 24 §6.1-6.2 (reforge, retune). 25 §7 E9/E10: MergeCrownCost and the +11 to +15 stone costs must be re-derived by the simulator with dungeons, events and guilds enabled together; do not pre-emptively tune them by hand.

enhance._doc: 08 §4.2. Success rates are authored as band endpoints only — the doc gives '85% -> 65%' and '50% -> 25%' and never states the interpolation, so perLevelSuccessRate is left unauthored.

reforge._doc: 24 §6.1 — quality re-roll, keep-best, unlimited attempts. Mirrored in luck.json; this is the forge-screen view of the same numbers.

retune._doc: 24 §6.2 — affix re-roll with lockable affixes and a wishlist. No C-rarity row: C items roll no affixes (08 §2).

inventory._doc: 08 §5 and 10 §4 — expansion prices are authored in currencies.json (the Crown ladder) and 10 §2 (the flat Soul Shard alternative). maxCapacity is the ceiling the ladder actually reaches: baseCapacity + inventoryExpansionMaxPurchases × inventoryExpansionSlotsPerPurchase = 120 + 10 × 20 = 320. It is not an independent number, and InventoryTuning refuses the document if the three stop agreeing.
